AI Agents with LangGraph: a complete, free, offline course on building agents as state graphs, taught through one lead qualification and booking agent. All runnable code uses a small local stand-in engine (lgx, in the repo) that mirrors LangGraph semantics on the Python standard library alone; every lesson pairs it with the equivalent real LangGraph 1.2.x code as a labelled reference snippet, with framework claims sourced and dated in RESEARCH.md. Key measured results: a plain pipeline beats the graph on linear work (56 calls against 59 executions and 84 checkpoint writes, Lesson 01); a memory write policy that saves everything scores 3 of 6 on returning-lead recall against 6 of 6 for confirmed-only writes with newest-wins reads (Lesson 24); the capstone agent passes 6 of 6 pre-fixed gates in its hardened variant (task success 1.0, policy escapes 0, crash-lead bookings 1, ledger entries 4, mean steps 4.92) against 2 of 6 for its as-built variant (Lesson 31).

Pointers: README.md (course map and scorecard), RESEARCH.md (dated field scan and the stand-in mapping), DESIGN.md (course design and honesty rules), PROGRESS.md (module checklist), lgx/ (the stand-in engine), fixtures/ (leads, schedule, policy, memory cases), 29-capstone-spec/capstone/gates.json (the fixed capstone gates).
